sloka: ततस्तु वानराः सर्वे भिन्नदेहा विचेतसः।व्यथिता विद्रवन्ति स्म रुधिरेण समुक्षिताः ।। ६.७३.३७ ।।
transliteration: tatastu vānarāḥ sarve bhinnadehā vicetasaḥ।vyathitā vidravanti sma rudhireṇa samukṣitāḥ ।। 6.73.37 ।।

translations.english: Filled with anger, Indrajith alone with nine, five, seven arrows tore the Vanaras into pieces.
